- Skeletal Sniper: Command: Gas Arrow cooldown is now 6 seconds (previously 8). - Gas Arrow, Gas Grenades and Decompose now have a limit of 6 Poison Clouds. - The Poison Cloud on Gas Arrow, Gas Grenade and Decompose now gain 20% more Radius per second, up to a maximum of 80% (all previously 50%, up to a maximum of 200%).
* Gas Arrow's explosion base damage has been reduced to 100%-312% at gem levels 1-20 (previously 250%-780%).
